spans.s:
† मय् मय्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. meare; see मी.

मय, m.
 1. A camel.
 2. A mule.

माय, i. e. मन् + य,
 I. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. An Asura.
 II. f.
 1.

. Trick in negotiation, diplomacy, Pañc. i. d. 404 (यो मायां कुरुते मूधः प्राणत्यागे धनादिषु, The fool who uses tricks about wealth, etc., his life being in danger).
 4.
मयु, m. The name of a class of attendants on Kuvera.

मायु,
 I. m. Bile.
 II. i. e. 2. मा + उ, Sounding, crying, at the end of comp. words; ved. गोमायु see s. v.

मयूख, m.
 1. A ray of light, Pañc. i. d. 92.
 2. Light, splendour, Ṛt. 6, 29.
 3. Beauty.
 --Comp.

मयूर,
 I. m.
 1. A peacock, Hit. i. d. 178, M.

. The name of a flower and of a plant.
 II. f. री, A peahen, Utt.

मायूर, i. e. मयूर + अ,
 I. adj., f. री.
 1. Belonging to, or coming from, peacocks,

Gorr.; agreeable to peacocks, Mālav. d. 20.
 2. Made of its feathers.
 II. n. A flock of peacocks.
मयोभू, i. e. मयस् (ved. Enjoyment), -भू, adj. Yielding enjoyment,

माया + मय, adj., f. यी,
 1. Illusive,

माया + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Deceitful, illusory, unreal.
 II. m. A name of Kansa.
 III. f. वती, The wife of Kāma.

मायायिन्, and मायाविन् मायाविन्, i. e. माया + विन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Deceitful, using tricks,

(विन्).
 2. Illusory, unreal.
 II. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. A cat.
मायिक, i. e. माया + इक, m. A juggler.

मायिन्, i. e. माया + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Wise,

= Rigv. i. 64, 7.
 2. Deceptive.
 II. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. A cheat.
 3. Agni, Viṣṇu, Brahman.
 --Comp.
+ मृग माया- + मृग, m. seeming a deer, not being one really,
